toastCreateBindFailed: Failed to create and bind worker
toastRestartUnsupported: {{title}}: the current runtime does not support restart
createTitle: Create and bind a new worker
createBindShortLabel: Create and bind a new worker
emptyState: Bind a team member to get started
confirmClear: Clear {{name}}'s conversation? This cannot be undone.
tipUnbind: Removes this card from the team panel (unbinds it). The agent itself keeps running and can be bound again later.
tipRestart: Stops the agent's CLI process and relaunches it in the same tmux window. Working directory and session are kept. Useful when the agent is stuck or after an upgrade.
tipCompact: Sends /compact to the agent: earlier conversation is distilled into a summary and work continues, freeing context window and saving tokens without losing key information.
tipClear: Sends /clear to the agent: wipes the entire conversation history and starts from scratch. Irreversible — a confirmation dialog is shown first.
tipFork: Clones a new agent: agent-summary distills the current conversation into a summary, which the new agent reads as its own inherited memory on startup. It appears as "Fork of …" nested under this agent — great for handing branch tasks to a fork to run in parallel without competing for context.
tipDelete: Permanently deletes the agent: closes its tmux window and removes the binding. Irreversible.
forkPreviewSubtitle: Review the context to inherit; edit the prompt before sending
forkTruncated: truncated — open to see full content
tipUpdate: Upgrade this agent's CLI to the latest version (npm install with a live log; retry switches registry). Running sessions are not interrupted; restart once to take effect.
updateDone: Update complete. Restart to take effect.
feishuCurrentChats: Feishu chats bound to this Agent
feishuNoChatBound: No Feishu chat is bound to this Agent. Select an app to create and bind a dedicated group.
feishuSendMessageFirst: Send any message to this Bot in Feishu first
